456:t_018:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No way! He stopped me!」

456:t_018:2.en:
$$ジン$$
「It's been a while, $$シンジ$$. I'm glad to see you again.」

456:t_018:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Swap with me, $$ジン$$! I'm going after that bastard $$ミカゲ$$!」

456:t_018:5.en:
$$ジン$$
「Once Chairwoman $$クレア$$ gives the OK.」

456:t_018:6.en:
$$クレア$$
「Very well. ...$$エレメント$$ Change! $$カグラ・デムリ$$, to $$ゲパルト$$!」

456:t_019:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「$$カグラ$$, $$ジン$$... You turn your blades on me yet again?」

456:t_019:1.en:
$$カグラ$$
「As long as you keep taking your grudge out on the wrong people, I'll fight you as many times as it takes!」

456:t_019:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I will not forgive any of you...」

456:t_020:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「How sad... To be left behind by the cycle of reincarnation, and refuse to accept change...」

456:t_020:1.en:
$$不動$$
「So his hatred runs this deep because of love...」

456:t_020:6.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Please save him... save $$ミカゲ$$.」

456:t_021:1.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... As elusive as ever.」

456:t_021:2.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「By the way, when did Chairwoman $$クレア$$ get aboard the $$クォーター$$?」

456:t_021:3.en:
$$クレア$$
「There's no need to worry about the small details. More importantly...」

456:t_021:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Alright, now it's getting exciting!」

456:t_022:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Anyway, that washed-up $$堕天翅$$ went home. Now let's have fun, just us!」

456:t_022:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Is that all you ever have in that head of yours!?」

456:t_022:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Huh... is that bad?」

456:t_022:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Guess it's a waste of breath even talking to you!」

456:t_022:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ha ha! Live true to yourself, Darling, you too!」

456:t_023:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Now that's interesting...! After sleeping for 12,000 years, they sound like a good wake-up call for me!」

456:t_023:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「$$アポロ$$! Because $$アクエリオン$$ slept for so long, it seems it can't separate or transform!」

456:t_023:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「The Head is yours! Use our power!」

456:t_023:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Right! I'll fight for the ones who aren't here, too!」

456:t_023:6.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「As expected of the original Elements! They're fired up!」

456:t_023:7.en:
$$カグラ$$
「We can't let ourselves be outdone, $$アマタ$$!」

456:t_024:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「With $$カグラ$$ here, $$ＥＶＯＬ$$ has more weapons to use! Let's do this!」

456:t_024:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Hold it, $$アマタ$$! Today we're the stars of the show!」

456:t_024:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Okay, $$アポロ$$. Just for today, I'll give up the spotlight.」

456:t_025:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Well, that $$アポロ$$ is $$アマタ$$'s past life.」

456:t_025:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「So it's like their souls are connected. No wonder they get along so fast.」

456:t_025:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's go, you guys! If your skills got rusty while I was asleep, I'll have a good laugh!」

456:t_025:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Same to you! If you're still half asleep, I'll knock you awake with the $$ライアット・ジャレンチ$$!」

456:t_025:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「In $$アポロ$$'s case, that doesn't seem to be a concern.」

456:t_025:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Show us! That crazy $$アクエリオン$$ stuff you pull every time!」

456:t_025:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「Let us see the brilliance of the sun you hold!」

456:t_025:8.en:
$$シリウス$$
「We're ready any time, $$アポロ$$!」

456:t_025:10.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! No mercy for anyone who uses brute force to do whatever they want with the world!」

456:t_026:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Not bad! It's a shame to settle this in a throwaway battlefield like this!」

456:t_026:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then I'll honestly admit defeat today. You guys have definitely gotten stronger.」

456:t_026:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The hunch I had when we first fought at $$ラース・バビロン$$... I was right after all.」

456:t_026:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「See ya, Darling! Next time, let's have fun on $$蒼の地球$$!」

456:t_027:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The battle between the $$堕天翅$$ and us has opened a hole in the defense network of $$蒼の地球$$.」

456:t_027:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Can we descend to Earth now?」

456:t_027:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I'm calling a briefing at once. As of now, $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ moves its battlefield to $$蒼の地球$$.」

456:t_027:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...While I was asleep, Earth got awfully troublesome.」

456:t_027:6.en:
$$シリウス$$
「To think there would be two Earths.」

456:t_027:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
「To be exact, there's one more, actually.」

456:t_027:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「It's thanks to you guys that $$アルテア$$ and $$ヴェーガ$$ were born.」

456:t_027:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'll hear the details as we go. First...」

456:t_027:12.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Welcome, $$アポロ$$. Let's fight together again.」

456:t_027:14.en:
$$アポロ$$
「But there's something I have to do before that.」

kept_omissions: 456:t_021:0: Malloy's 行ってしまった - subject kept as plural 'They' (Fudou/Toma/Kaworu left); scene does not settle whether Fudou alone is meant.
456:t_021:1: Shrade's 相変わらずの神出鬼没ぶり - subject dropped ('As elusive as ever'); presumably Fudou but not certain.
456:t_023:0: Graham's 欲望を解放したか - addressee inferred as Elunaluna, written 'You've unleashed your desires' (could be muttered about her).
uncertain: 456:t_022:0: 堕天翅崩れ rendered 'washed-up Shadow Angel'; taken to mean Mikage who just withdrew (or possibly Toma).
456:t_018:1: 断ち切る力 = 'power to sever' (Jin's Gepard ability).
456:t_025:7: Banjo's fragment 君達の持つ太陽の輝きを - I supplied 'Let us see' continuing Kappei's 見せてくれよ.
456:t_025:4: ジャレンチ mapped to the token for Riot Jarenti (only Jarenti entry in the sheet).
456:t_027:2: 地球 written 'Earth' (vs the 蒼の地球 token) because Jeffrey says plain 地球.
456:t_020:2: speaker 頭翅 uses #pilot; 'Let us go' (formal register of Toma).
456:t_023:6: Element/Elements literal, per Element Change precedent in dlg_2063_04.
